subject.callable: direct Triton float32 causal paged GQA attention
subject.boundary: one launch of twenty programs writes the complete 5x4x16 public output

tasks.task_statement: Compute complete float32 causal paged GQA attention for query lengths 3 and 2, KV lengths 13 and 10, block size 8, supplied physical block tables, scale 0.25, inclusive left window 4 and no softcap.

input_map.basis: tokens 0..2 and 3..4 form the two packed query sequences
the kernel fixes the logical KV lengths for its two sequences
the kernel multiplies every QK score by exact binary 0.25
the mask requires source position at or before the absolute query position
the mask includes keys with position-source <= 4; causal masking makes the right side unbounded
the kernel does not apply score softcap
query, caches and output are contiguous float32 tensors
